title: Reduce, reuse, recycle
info: The three Rs help with waste. Reduce means use less. Reuse means use it again. Recycle means make old material into something new.
Reducing comes first, because the best waste is waste you never make.

questions.q: Using a bottle again for water is

options: turning old material into new things

questions.q: Which R is the best first step?
options: recycle only after you waste a lot
questions.explain: If you never take the extra bag, there is nothing to throw away.

questions.q: A ripped page used as scrap paper is
Type the R that means use less.
